purpose: Observed market-factor context for hypothetical exposures; not an entity exposure assessment or model validation

source_trm.name: Tasa Representativa del Mercado (TRM)
source_trm.monthly_sampling: last available daily observation in each month

source_dtf.publisher: Banco de la República via Atlas Económico; governed derived file
source_dtf.method: monthly mean, only complete months through 2026-09

hypothetical_exposures.assumption: Constant outstanding principal, no hedges, taxes, amortization, accrued interest or cash-flow timing

formulas.dtf_annualized_cost_change_cop: COP 100,000,000,000 * (DTF_t - DTF_t-12) / 100; DTF changes are percentage points

ibr: Not used: this application isolates a DTF-indexed hypothetical peso liability. IBR-based repricing requires a specified tenor, reset convention, spread, day count and a separately governed IBR vintage.
limitations: TRM and DTF are public market reference series, not a company's realized FX or interest cash flows.
The FX and DTF sensitivities are separate and must not be summed as a joint loss; no joint shock distribution or correlation model is estimated.
Static principal, immediate pass-through and no hedge assumptions are illustrative. No entity exposure, hedge effectiveness, covenant breach or decision threshold is validated.

The snapshot is a point-in-time extraction; source metadata may include observations dated after the local download date because of publication/time-zone timing. Use each observation date as published.
The DTF raw SDMX source bytes are not preserved in this repository; lineage and derived-file hash are documented in the treasury-and-ALM README.
